import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile, time
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rev28-tests-') as s:
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', SECRET_KEY='dummy-secret-key-for-ci-tests', DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///' + s + '/db.sqlite3',
               REDIS_URL='redis://127.0.0.1:16379', CELERY_TASK_ALWAYS_EAGER='True', INTERNAL_API_TOKEN='dummy-internal-api-token-for-ci',
               FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY='S-c9WBE3DEJE2R7i-b-sOmegRChW2McTDIOWcrG0-C8=', CORE_API_URL='http://127.0.0.1:18080', SIGN_INTERNAL_URL='http://sign.test', TMPDIR=s)
    for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: env.pop(k, None)
    t = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 'dealroom_sign/tests/test_placement_r28.py', 'dealroom_sign/tests/test_placement_r13.py'],
                       cwd='/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend', env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=540)
    print(r.returncode, round(time.time() - t)); print(r.stdout[-1200:]); print(r.stderr[-600:])
